cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Merciful Lie
cards.instruction: Choose a truth your character believes would hurt someone. Keep it from them, even as honesty becomes harder.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll sort out the bakery's response. Your cake needs the right setting; it's too special for them to sell by the slice.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Their letter says inedible. I thought I'd found something I was good at.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You have. It's a display cake, and we'll present it that way. You can choose the window you want it in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ring them and ask for their front window.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. You make the call; I'll sit beside you and explain the display category first. We'll give them the right words before they upset you with the wrong ones again.
